name: Cake x 3! -Ichigo Ichie-
source:
Main character hears about a cake contest with the first prize of ability to open his own shop. He does not even have a finalized recipe of the cake. Can he really win?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角听说一场蛋糕大赛的冠军可以获得开店资格，可他连参赛蛋糕的配方都还没有定下来。他真的能夺冠吗？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
